chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from a man, raising it, said:
Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: 'The prey is not shot with something that is bigger than it.'
ai.seo_question: What is the rule regarding the size of the projectile used to hunt prey according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi articulates the principle of proportionality in hunting, prohibiting the use of projectiles significantly larger than the prey to ensure a swift, humane kill and prevent unnecessary suffering or waste of meat. Within Shia fiqh, this ruling is often discussed in the context of *adab al-dhabh* (etiquette of slaughter) and the ethical treatment of animals, reflecting the broader Islamic emphasis on mercy and efficiency in resource utilization.

en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from a man, raising it, said,
‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Do not shoot at the hunted prey with something which is bigger than it’.
en.sarwar: 12. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from a man in a marfu ‘ manner who has said the following:

“Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘A prey must not be hit with something bigger than the prey.’” (It is because the cause of death becomes confused with the weight and force of the hunter).
